meta.what: Beyonder abilities, authorities and mythical forms per pathway and Sequence
meta.denominator: Lord of the Mysteries wiki: the 32 "<Pathway> Pathway/Abilities" pages split at "Sequence N: Name" headings; one row per bolded entry under New Abilities, Authorities, and one Mythical Creature Form row per Sequence that has the heading (lotm-wiki-current-pages-2026-11-03)
meta.split_rule: Rows are ordered by sha1 of "nextcells-v1:<id>"; those whose first hex byte is below 0x40 are the tuning sample, the only rows the prompt or normaliser may be adjusted on; every other row is held out and reported. Dial: seed and fraction; the fixed seed is the reported one.
meta.label: the pathway (the book's own class); the grammar object is scored against the pre-registered PATHWAY_OF_OBJECT map with the pathway and Sequence names blanked from the evidence. Upper bound: the abilities' own wording still carries the pathway's domain words
meta.fold_rule: A guessed class becomes a sheet field only where held-out hits beat the majority baseline over the labelled held-out rows (PWC2); otherwise the sheet drops it and the note says model tier, unchecked.
